submissions.title: Effingham County residents file damages lawsuit against OpenAI, county officials over Project Camellia
submissions.excerpt: accuses OpenAI, Effingham County officials and others of enacting a conspiracy and racketeering to bring the data center plan to life
submissions.note: NEW project, not currently in the tracker. This is the second (RICO) suit filed Nov 6, 2026 in Effingham County State Court, alleging a secrecy scheme around the county's approval of the project; a separate Sept. 2026 suit challenges the underlying zoning ordinance and open-meetings compliance. Background for reviewer: widely reported (July 2026) as a 3.2 GW, 25-year Georgia Power PPA phased 2028-2032, with capex reported inconsistently across outlets as $20B-$30B — left blank here rather than guessed. Those background figures come from secondary press I could not re-verify against the primary OpenAI/Georgia Power announcements this run (see report caveat on network access). Submitting now because the lawsuit itself is the new, dated development.

submissions.excerpt: xAI operated at least 35 combustion turbines, along with other sources of air pollution, without required permits

submissions.title: PIF-backed Humain secures up to $1.2bn to expand AI infrastructure
submissions.excerpt: signed two financing agreements with HUMAIN in Riyadh, worth up to SAR 2.5 billion
submissions.note: Financing update touching tracked project HUMAIN AI Factories Phase 1 (Riyadh) and HUMAIN's wider build-out — omitting projectId, live id unreachable this run. Saudi National Infrastructure Fund (Infra) signed the first tranche (~SAR 2.5bn / $667M) of a Davos-announced framework: one facility financing GPUs (~25 MW IT load), another financing substations/transmission sized for up to 1 GW of future IT capacity. This is debt financing, not a confirmed capacity-online event — do not read as MW delivered. Coincides with, but is separate from, Aramco's Nov 1, 2026 close of a 49% HUMAIN equity stake (~$2.6B).

claims.methodology: Reported as SAR 2.5bn (~$667M) financing signed Nov 8 2026, first tranche of a larger up-to-$1.2bn framework; figure from secondary press, not independently verified against a primary Infra/HUMAIN release this run.

submissions.title: Drax and Brookfield strike investment deal of up to £20bn for data centre
submissions.excerpt: Brookfield estimates total investment could exceed £20 billion, with an initial £2.5 billion for phase one
submissions.suggestedProjectName: Brookfield-Drax-Radiant Data Center (Selby, North Yorkshire, UK)
submissions.note: NEW project, not currently tracked. Gigawatt-scale AI data center planned at Drax Power Station (Selby, North Yorkshire), using Drax's existing 4GW grid connection and 2.6GW of dispatchable generation on site. Phase 1 targets up to 100MW, online Q1 2028; phases 2-3 could reach 1GW by the early 2030s. Early-stage: no tenant, no planning approval, no final investment decision yet, so capacity/capex figures below are company targets, not confirmed build. Site power vs IT load not yet distinguished by the companies.

claims.methodology: Company target for full build-out across three phases extending past 2031, per Drax/Brookfield/Radiant announcement; phase 1 alone is ~100MW.
Brookfield's stated ceiling ('could exceed £20 billion') for full build-out, not committed spend; figure is in GBP, not USD, despite the metric type.

submissions.title: Data center moratorium extended in city of Charlotte: What to know
submissions.excerpt: the council adopted a measure that extends the city's data center moratorium until Oct. 18, 2027
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Charlotte City Council voted unanimously Oct 26, 2026 to extend its existing 150-day data center permitting moratorium (which was due to expire Nov 5, 2026) through Oct 18, 2027 — roughly 11 more months. New-permit approvals are paused citywide; permits already issued are unaffected. Stated purpose is to give the council time to write new zoning/siting rules, partly pending NC General Assembly action next session. No specific tracked project in this database sits in Charlotte, so no project link.
